Only methods declared in candy-mdview/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\MdView

Application final class

candy-mdview entry point. Registers a single default command so users can invoke candy-mdview <file> without a subcommand name.

MethodSummary
__construct()
static versionString(): stringThe version Symfony's --version will print, phar-aware: inside an archive the build manifest wins — the hardcoded literal would otherwise freeze a number no release process produced, while the manifest names the exact tag the artifact was cut from. A bare dev-build stamp is working-tree noise, not a version, and falls through. Outside an archive nothing is consulted and the historical 0.1.0 answers byte-true (pinned by ApplicationTest and by the precedence test here).
static hostArchive(): stringThe real-filesystem path of the phar archive hosting this install, or '' when this code is not running from an archive. Three identities, first answer wins (measured on PHP 8.3.6 while porting the archive-version guard): Phar::running() names the archive for code executing inside it; in the stub region running() answers '' and __FILE__ names the self-naming archive; a phar:// prefix on this file's own __FILE__ covers shapes where a class was loaded from the archive but running() stayed empty.

Config final class

The persisted-preferences file: mdview.json under the XDG config home (glow keeps ~/.config/glow/glow.yml; this port uses JSON to avoid a YAML dependency). Every setting the CLI takes as a flag or environment fact can live here instead — theme, style, width, pager, keymap — and the resolution precedence is flag > environment > file > default.

MethodSummary
static empty(): selfThe empty config — every lookup answers "no position".
static defaultPath(): ?stringResolve the file location: MDVIEW_CONFIG names it directly (the test seam and the --config-equivalent door); an explicitly EMPTY value disables file lookup entirely — the hermetic escape the suite uses. Otherwise $XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config, under mdview/mdview.json. Returns null when even HOME is unknown — there is simply no file to consult.
static load(?string $path = null): selfLoad the file at $path (or the default location when null). Absent files and absent directories yield the empty config; a present file is held to the door law (regular file, capped, JSON object, known keys, typed values) or the run refuses with exit code 2.

DocumentGate final class

The ONE document door: is_file → regular-file re-check on the opened handle → size cap → capped read → binary refusal, in that order, used by every path bytes take to enter a render — the file argument, piped stdin, and the pager's reload sweep alike. Before this consolidation the sweep bypassed all of it (a 20 MB replacement grew past the "64 MiB contract" into an OOM of the live pager, and an ELF swapped onto the watched path rendered as a success frame), and stdin was an unbounded slurp while the file lane refused the same bytes cleanly.

MethodSummary
static readFile(string $path): stringRead a local document path under the full gate.
static readStream($stream, string $label): stringRead a piped document stream under the same size and binary contract. The read itself is bounded (MAX+1 bytes), so an endless producer is refused, not slurped.
static refuseBinary(string $raw, string $label): voidRefuse to render binary payloads. Mistyping onto a PNG/PDF/ELF must not spray escape sequences (possible cursor/color-state changes) at the terminal with a success code. Probe: a NUL byte ANYWHERE in the document is conclusive (the cap already holds it whole and str_contains is a memchr-class scan — the old head-only probe let 9000 printable bytes hide an ELF tail); beyond that, a control-character ratio above 5% of the 8 KiB head window is refusal-grade for anything a human would call a text file (UTF-8 text and its multi-byte sequences contain no C0 bytes).

HttpFetch final class

The URL input door (finding 008): glow's second documented invocation is glow https://example.com/README.md; the port used to answer "no such file" because nothing in src/ knew what a scheme was.

MethodSummary
static isRemote(string $arg): boolWhether a file argument names a remote document (glow's parity door).
static fetch(string $url): stringFetch $url under the transport caps and hand the bytes to the shared document gate. Refusals leave through the usage channel: every one of them is an InvalidArgumentException naming the URL (credentials from its userinfo part never echoed) and the reason.

Per-library translation facade for candy-mdview.

MdViewModel final class

Pager Model used by RenderCommand when -p / --pager is set. Wraps a Viewport containing the already-rendered (styled) text. Standard reader keys are forwarded to the Viewport; plain q / Esc / Ctrl+C exit the loop (modified runes like Alt+q belong to the reader, never to the exit gate).

MethodSummary
static fromContent(string $content, int $width = 80, int $height = 24): self
withDocument(string $name): selfEnter document mode: paint a status header and reserve its row. The viewport height shrinks by one so header + body never exceed the terminal, and every later resize recomputes with the same accounting.
withWatch(string $path, \Closure $reRender): selfArm the auto-reload watch on $path. Every returned instance carries the closure forward (immutability), so later key handling cannot silently drop the watch state.
isWatching(): bool
withReflow(\Closure $reflowAt): selfArm the resize-reflow path (finding 014). The closure receives the live column count on every geometry-changing WindowSizeMsg and returns the fully re-rendered document text; the viewport re-clips scroll offsets against it. Armed ONLY for an unpinned width — an explicit --width is a user decision the resize leg must never override.
withKeymap(array $overrides): selfReplace the default chords for this model's own keys (the config file's keymap door, finding 036). Overrides merge onto the current map, so a partial keymap keeps every untouched binding; the Escape and Ctrl+C quit legs are structural and stay whatever the map says.
init(): ?\Closure
update(Msg $msg): array
view(): string
isExited(): bool
subscriptions(): ?\SugarCraft\Core\Subscriptions

RenderCommand final class

Default candy-mdview command. Reads Markdown from a file argument or stdin, renders it via Renderer, and either prints it to the terminal (default) or opens a fullscreen pager via MdViewModel when -p / --pager is set.

MethodSummary

static setTerminalCheckCallback(?callable $callback): void

static pickTheme(string $name): ThemeResolve a theme name. The lookup lives in sugar-markdown's Theme (P1-12c-mdview): stock names through Theme::byName(), the bundled JSON slugs through Theme::catalogByName(). The roster and the two aliases remain this CLI's contract.
